values: 防守兵种、升级阶段与战斗单位
防守建筑与英雄等级升级关系
先知及变形的6阶随机候选池

主配置数量、原始属性、技能与武器机制。

名称、文案、常用物编配置与继承。

结论、源代码位置与适用范围。
原始源代码片段及精确行号。
所有明细表可筛选，已冻结标题及识别列。
说明文字、物编数值、脚本调用分别列示；文案冲突不直接覆盖配置。
静态字段并非运行后的最终伤害；HP 与 realHP 等列分别保留。
空白表示源数据缺失。stockMax/stockStart 空白不填成 0、3 或无限。
原始注册项与技能挂载次数不等于可玩兵种、可用技能数量。
防守表含升级、变形及2个仅注册项。请按“获得方式”筛选，不能按行数统计独立兵种。
17种建造者为AP菜单静态可达；AR/SD随机范围尚未验证。
空 abilList 不表示没有机制；还需核对武器、脚本与运行时追加能力。
REA不支持原始 w3x。原图由专用解析器提取，REA仅登记派生ZIP文件及哈希。

function A_SushuiInfernoSpellTrueFire takes nothing returns nothing

call UnitDamageTargetBJ(GetEventDamageSource(),GetTriggerUnit(),(GetUnitStateSwap(UNIT_STATE_LIFE,GetTriggerUnit())*0.03),ATTACK_TYPE_NORMAL,DAMAGE_TYPE_FIRE)

endfunction

function A_SushuiFighterSpellDeathExplode takes nothing returns nothing
local group ydl_group
local unit ydl_unit
set Temp_Point=GetUnitLoc(GetDyingUnit())
call ForGroupBJ(YDWEGetUnitsInRangeOfLocMatchingNull(300.00,Temp_Point,Condition(function G_SushuiFighterSpellDeathExplode)),function D_SushuiFighterSpellDeathExplode)
call RemoveLocation(Temp_Point)
call GroupClear(GetLastCreatedGroup())
call DestroyGroup(GetLastCreatedGroup())
set ydl_group=null
set ydl_unit=null
set Temp_Point=GetUnitLoc(GetDyingUnit())
call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ(Temp_Point,"Units\\NightElf\\Wisp\\WispExplode.mdl")

set T_SushuiFighterSpellDeathExplode=CreateTrigger()
call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(T_SushuiFighterSpellDeathExplode, EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DEATH)

endfunction

function AJ takes nothing returns nothing
call SetUnitInvulnerable(GetTriggerUnit(),false)
set T=GetUnitLoc(GetSpellAbilityUnit())
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'u006',Player(-1+(GetUnitUserData(GetSpellAbilityUnit()))),T,bj_UNIT_FACING)
set Y=bj_lastCreatedUnit
call UnitAddAbility(Y,'A06Z')
call IssueTargetOrderById(Y,$D0085,GetSpellAbilityUnit())
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(4.,'BTLF',Y)
call RemoveLocation(T)
endfunction

supplementalEvidence.summary: 每1秒遍历B03Q目标；生命百分比>2才减1.2个百分点，结果至少1%。直接设置生命，不是普通伤害事件。原生Area1=800用于Buff覆盖。

script_evidence.code:
function lh takes nothing returns boolean
return(Dx)and(bi)
endfunction
function Lh takes nothing returns boolean
return(UnitHasBuffBJ(GetFilterUnit(),'B03Q'))
endfunction
function mh takes nothing returns boolean
return(yv<1.)
endfunction
function Mh takes nothing returns boolean
return(GetUnitLifePercent(GetEnumUnit())>2.)
endfunction
function ph takes nothing returns nothing
if(Mh())then
set yv=(GetUnitLifePercent(GetEnumUnit())-1.2)
if(mh())then
set yv=1.
endif
call SetUnitLifePercentBJ(GetEnumUnit(),yv)
endif
endfunction

function QH takes nothing returns nothing
call DestroyGroup(z)
set z=rN(bj_mapInitialPlayableArea,Condition(function Lh))
call ForGroupBJ(z,function ph)
call DestroyGroup(z)

set uE=CreateTrigger()
call TriggerRegisterTimerEventPeriodic(uE,1.)
call TriggerAddCondition(uE,Condition(function lh))
call TriggerAddAction(uE,function QH)
set UE=CreateTrigger()

supplementalEvidence.summary: 施法时160原始坐标范围内同玩家、非施法者且没有A060的单位，添加A060/A065/A063；A060 DataB1=.65，其余缺省字段不能从原型同名字段擅自继承。

script_evidence.code:
function ik takes nothing returns boolean
return(GetSpellAbilityId()=='A061')
endfunction
function Trig_Guardian_Spirit_Effect_Func002002003001 takes nothing returns boolean
return(GetOwningPlayer(GetFilterUnit())==GetOwningPlayer(GetSpellAbilityUnit()))
endfunction
function Trig_Guardian_Spirit_Effect_Func002002003002 takes nothing returns boolean
return(GetFilterUnit()!=GetSpellAbilityUnit())
endfunction
function ak takes nothing returns boolean
return GetBooleanAnd((GetOwningPlayer(GetFilterUnit())==GetOwningPlayer(GetSpellAbilityUnit())),(GetFilterUnit()!=GetSpellAbilityUnit()))
endfunction
function nk takes nothing returns boolean
return(GetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A060',GetEnumUnit())==0)
endfunction
function Vk takes nothing returns nothing
if(nk())then
call UnitAddAbility(GetEnumUnit(),'A060')
call UnitAddAbility(GetEnumUnit(),'A065')
call UnitAddAbility(GetEnumUnit(),'A063')
endif
endfunction
function Ek takes nothing returns nothing
set T=GetUnitLoc(GetSpellAbilityUnit())
set Ex=EN(160.,T,Condition(function ak))
call ForGroupBJ(Ex,function Vk)
call RemoveLocation(T)
call DestroyGroup(z)
endfunction

set bX=CreateTrigger()
call TriggerRegisterAnyUnitEventBJ(bX,EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT)
call TriggerAddCondition(bX,Condition(function ik))
call TriggerAddAction(bX,function Ek)
